name: Gearbox
text: Run EXCAVA on the distilled 70B variant fine-tuned on EXCAVA’s exact task data. The 405B model’s raw scale won’t help if it’s not aligned with our specific task—distilled models cut noise and lock in the exact behaviors we need. The trade-off is accepting a smaller model’s limits, but we gain precision and speed without chasing bleeding-edge flops.

name: Torque
text: The distilled 70B’s risk isn’t just "smaller model limits"—it’s that fine-tuning on EXCAVA’s task data locks us into yesterday’s patterns, crippling future adaptation when the task drifts. Instead, run the 405B on a narrow, high-quality prompt set curated for EXCAVA’s edge cases; if latency breaks the pipeline, we’ll know the bottleneck isn’t the model but the system design. Settle it by benchmarking both on a live EXCAVA slice—no dry runs.
